input.complaints: High fever for 3 days with severe headache, pain behind the eyes, body aches and a mild rash on the trunk since this morning.
input.findings: Temp 39.2 C, BP 110/70, pulse 92/min. No bleeding, no abdominal pain, no vomiting. Eating and drinking, passing urine normally. No blood tests done yet. Several neighbours had similar fevers recently.
